author: Greljo, Admir and Salko, Jakub and Smolkovic, Aleks and Stangl, Peter
title: Rare b decays meet high-mass Drell-Yan
abstract: Rare b hadron decays are considered excellent probes of new semileptonic four-fermion interactions of microscopic origin. However, the same interactions also correct the high-mass Drell-Yan tails. In this work, we revisit the first statement in the context of this complementarity and chart the space of short-distance new physics that could show up in rare b decays. We analyze the latest b -> q l l measurements, where q = d or s and l = e or mu, including the most recent LHCb RK(*) update, together with the latest charged and neutral current high-mass Drell-Yan data. For the rare B decays global fit, the Gaussian approximation at the best-fit point is Cuniv.9 = -Cuniv.10 = -0.29 +/- 0.13, DeltaCbsmumu.9 = -DeltaCbsmumu.10 = -0.08 +/- 0.07.
